cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Technically, Yes
cards.instruction: Comply with every agreement in the narrowest possible way while insisting you honored it completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You asked me to move a box; it's beside the van. Done. Remember my lesson about precise instructions?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Better. You've supplied a number. I'll move all twenty beside the van; that fulfills your request.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Inside the van, please. The sofa has to fit too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll put the boxes on the sofa. Both inside. You remembered space; next time remember the upholstery I taught you to protect.

reason: Replace the unsupported desire to sit on a sofa during transport with an actual packing concern, making the teacher blame shift relevant to the requested move.
